name: ten_times_stronger
description: Every motor 10 times stronger: 10 times the force limit and 10 times the stiffness
notes: Both numbers go up together: with the old stiffness a motor would only reach its new force limit far off its target, so a higher limit alone would barely change how hard the duck pushes. Checked stable on 2026-10-31 (no simulation warnings with random commands).
